simple.meaning: קָוֶה (qâveh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a (measuring) cord (as if for binding).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at 1 Kings 7:23. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קָוֶה (H6961) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: קָוֶה (qâveh) / H6961 is traced through 1 Kings 7:23, Jeremiah 31:39, Zechariah 1:16 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: He made the molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in shape. Its height was five cubits; and a line of thirty cubits encircled it.

timeline.evidenceText: He made the molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in shape. Its height was five cubits; and a line of thirty cubits encircled it.
He made the molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in shape. Its height was five cubits; and a line of thirty cubits encircled it.
The measuring line will go out further straight onward to the hill Gareb, and will turn toward Goah.
Therefore Yahweh says: “I have returned to Jerusalem with mercy. My house shall be built in it,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and a line shall be stretched out over Jerusalem.” ’
